quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look for trains before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on intersecting roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop at a stop sign. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the road curves ahead. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: The center lane is for left turns only. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. Stop completely and check for pedestrians and other traffic. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are in the area ahead. Drive carefully and watch for workers near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending soon.
The left lane is ending soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end. Move to another lane when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign tells you that you are approaching a divided highway with a median separating traffic directions.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed when road and weather conditions are good.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed when road and weather conditions are good.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit. When conditions are poor, slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns you to be careful when wet conditions make the road slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell drivers to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop for other vehicles or pedestrians. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that hospital emergency services are to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show which direction the road curves. This sign points left, so the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several of these signs along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers about a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turning, and increase distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is ahead. You should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge ahead at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Be careful and slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. Wherever you see this sign, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is always at the top and green at the bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on green, you must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on green, you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with traffic signals. It tells drivers turning left on green that they do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers as indicated on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride beside traffic here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that enforces traffic rules. It means parking is not permitted in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down when approaching railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must let them pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Reduce speed as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and give the right-of-way to other vehicles and pedestrians. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of low overhead clearance ahead.

questions.question: When you see a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Look for pedestrians at intersections and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: When a driver's left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the driver:
questions.explanation: Drivers use hand signals instead of turn signals. A left arm extended straight out means the driver plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The safe speed limit for residential areas.
The safe speed for leaving a highway.
The safe speed for entering a highway.
The safe speed in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed for leaving a highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the recommended safe speed for a highway exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Look both ways and yield to other traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T-shaped intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are prohibited in this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of curves or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic must go on a one-way street. You must drive in the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a divider between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you to a steep downhill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits only.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and carpools only.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits only.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: This sign warns you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that railroad tracks cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign means you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on crash. Turn around safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep uphill ahead. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The road dips steeply to cross the tracks. Low-clearance vehicles may drag or get stuck.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and let pedestrians and cross traffic go first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to show no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you about an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a T intersection ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection ahead. A road is joining from the right.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show turns or stops instead of turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is prohibited. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign do?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They tell you about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign means people may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Prepare to stop completely before going forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign orders you to drive on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead splits into a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at this intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet, making your vehicle harder to control.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It tells you what you must do by law. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill slope is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points with one finger?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points with one finger, all riders should move into a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or with your turn signals. When your left arm is extended straight out, it means you plan to turn left or move left into another lane.

questions.question: What is the order of traffic light colors from bottom to top?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are arranged from bottom to top in this order: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the hill ahead.
Trucks are on the hill ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or steep downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road you are on ends ahead.
You must go either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at this exact speed.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive this speed through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum speed you can drive on this road. If roads are wet, icy, or snowy, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic merge in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic merge in.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, make room for the incoming vehicles. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane will end. All traffic in the right lane must move to the left lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Group riders use hand signals to communicate. When the lead rider holds their left arm straight out with palm up, then swings the arm upward, it tells the group to increase speed.

questions.question: You see this sign above your lane. What does it mean?

options.text: You can continue on the freeway or exit from this lane.
You can stay in this lane and go through the interchange.
You must exit if you stay in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in this lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane will leave the freeway. If you stay in this lane, you will exit. To continue on the freeway, you must change lanes before the exit.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider points their left arm down with palm facing back, the group should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black symbols. This sign warns that the right lane will end or the road will get narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road curves right, then left.
The road curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the road ahead will curve to the right first, then curve to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means you cannot do that action. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do if you see this sign?

options.text: You can pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You can pass if you know the road ahead.
You can pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that passing is not allowed in this area. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or yellow light, and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot turn left at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a lane is ending. Get ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: At a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic pass before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road you are on meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road you are on meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road intersects with a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (such as 13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can either turn right or continue straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot drive into the road or driveway from your current direction. You must turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Slow down and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows one way only. You cannot enter from the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead where another road crosses.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or with your turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means you are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with their palm facing down and then swings their arm down to their side, riders behind them should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means drivers turning left at a green light must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians in or heading toward the intersection go first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that construction or maintenance work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
